title: English League Cup heats up with knockout ties and ticket demand
seoTitle: English League Cup: Tickets, Prices & Live TV Info
subtitle: Competition draws attention with knockout clashes and spots in the next rounds
excerpt: Everything you need to know about the English League Cup, including ticket info, prices, live broadcasts, and the knockout clash.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The hunt for tickets and broadcast options for the English League Cup, also known as the Carabao Cup or EFL Cup, is intensifying with the arrival of the competition's new stages and the entry of Premier League clubs into the fray. The season is moving at a fast pace toward the final at Wembley Stadium, scheduled for March 21, as teams like Southampton and West Ham prepare for crucial knockout ties.

How to secure tickets for cup matches

Buying tickets directly through the clubs' official websites is considered the safest way to follow the clashes. Season ticket holders and registered members have priority access periods to secure their seats, as competition tickets are not automatically included in the annual package. Alternatively, fans also turn to secondary resale channels, such as StubHub.

Ticket prices across different stages

Prices vary depending on the stage of the tournament and the importance of the match. In the early rounds, face value for adults ranges from £10 to £30, while youth tickets range from £1 to £10. In the quarter-finals and semi-finals, official prices rise to a range between £20 and £60. For the final at Wembley, face values usually fluctuate between approximately £40 and £150.

Southampton and West Ham clash for third-round spot

The knockout tie between Southampton and West Ham takes place at St. Mary's Stadium, determining qualification from the second round. Southampton arrives buoyed by a league victory over Stoke City, 3-1, with goals from Cyle Larin, Divin Mubama, and Ryan Manning. On the other side, West Ham is trying to regain momentum after a recent defeat to Charlton Athletic, seeking redemption under manager Nuno Espírito Santo.

Where to watch matches live

For viewers in Brazil, the match between Southampton and West Ham will be broadcast live on ESPN and Disney+. In the UK, Sky Sports airs all season matches, with streaming options via NOW and the broadcaster's app. In the United States, coverage is handled by CBS Sports and live TV platforms like Fubo.

With information from Goal.com, VEJA.
